question: Which country has the LONGEST coastline?
cover_emoji_why: a wave is the topic word (coastline); all three options are coastal nations, the icon favours none

post.premise: The longest coast on Earth is mostly frozen and mostly empty
post.bait: Russia, Indonesia or Canada — which did you pick? 👇
keywords: which country has the longest coastline
post.sources_line: CIA World Factbook; Statistics Canada; Britannica

youtube.title: Which country has the longest coastline? It would take 27 years to walk 🌊
youtube.description:
Russia, Indonesia or the third one? One nation's shoreline runs more than 200,000 km along three oceans — nearly four times the runner-up — and most of it is frozen for much of the year. Walk it at 20 km a day and you would need almost three decades.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the comparison, the island count, and how long the walk would take.
Which did you pick?

research.topic: Longest coastline: Canada 202,080 km (CIA World Factbook), Indonesia 54,716 km, Russia 37,653 km; Canada has 52,455 islands (Statistics Canada); Pacific, Arctic and Atlantic coasts.

myths.myth: Russia has the longest coastline because it is the biggest country.
myths.reality: Russia's coastline is about 37,653 km; Canada's is 202,080 km, more than five times longer, because of its Arctic archipelago.

landscape.our_gap: Feed clips say 'Canada' as a one-liner; nobody draws the three coastlines against each other, counts the islands and times the walk on a moving map.
